requiredText: What counts as before-and-after evidence for an old-house renovation?
怎样确认旧屋翻新前后对比属于真实完工证据？

faqs_zh.a: 不一定。可以先根据屋况区分安全相关项目、必须维修项目、功能改善和外观升级，再决定是否分阶段处理。
faqs_zh.q: 旧屋翻新一定要全屋一起做吗？

faqs_zh.a: 费用取决于房屋面积、现场状况、拆除范围、电线水管、防水、厨房浴室、柜体、材料和施工复杂度。具体数字报价需要现场评估和确认范围后提供。
faqs_zh.q: 旧屋翻新费用受什么影响？

faqs_zh.a: 不能直接承诺一定需要更换。较旧房屋通常建议先检查电线负载、水管状态和漏水风险，再根据安全和使用需求决定。
faqs_zh.q: 旧屋一定要换电线和水管吗？

faqs_zh.a: 可以。设计方案、效果图方案和材料方向可作为规划参考，但除非业主提供真实项目照片并确认可公开使用，否则不能写成真实完工案例。
faqs_zh.q: 可以先看设计方案或效果图吗？

faqs_zh.a: 先确认图片是否来自同一处真实物业、拍摄视角是否可比较、实际完成了哪些工程，以及业主是否同意公开使用。效果图或拟议方案只能用于沟通规划，不能作为已完工证明。本页现有“现状/方案”对比图标注为 AI 生成的规划概念，不应理解为客户项目或施工结果。
faqs_zh.q: 怎样确认旧屋翻新前后对比属于真实完工证据？

faqs_en.a: Not always. The scope can be prioritized into safety-related items, necessary repairs, function upgrades, and visual improvements before deciding whether phased work is suitable.
faqs_en.q: Does an old house renovation need to be done all at once?

faqs_en.a: Cost depends on property size, site condition, demolition, wiring, plumbing, waterproofing, kitchen and bathroom scope, cabinets, materials, and work complexity. Specific numeric pricing should only be provided after site assessment and confirmed scope.
faqs_en.q: What affects old house renovation cost?

faqs_en.a: Not automatically. Older homes should first be checked for electrical load, pipe condition, leakage risk, and safety requirements before deciding what needs replacement.
faqs_en.q: Do old houses always need rewiring or pipe replacement?

faqs_en.a: Yes. Design concepts, rendering concepts, and material directions can be prepared as planning references. Unless approved real project photos are provided, they must not be presented as completed project proof.
faqs_en.q: Can I review design or rendering concepts first?

faqs_en.a: Ask whether the images show the same actual property and comparable views, which work was completed, and whether the owner has approved the photos for public use. A planning concept or rendering is a discussion reference, not proof of completed work. 比较报价前：先核对整体项目步骤

requiredText: Before comparing quotations: a project checklist
比较报价前：先核对整体项目步骤

publicCurrentProjection.content_zh:
直接答案：最合适的报价不一定最便宜或最长，而是能把交付结果、假设、责任和变更流程写清楚，让双方在施工期间都能使用。

使用方法：把下列各项替换为本项目的实际尺寸、明确责任人、获批图纸和书面记录，再用于报价、审批或施工决定。

比较报价前：先核对整体项目步骤

比较各项报价前，可先按项目整理：提供现场资料和使用重点；确认现场测量与现状；明确设计范围；复核分项报价和材料；确认施工责任与协调方式；记录验收、缺陷处理和交付安排。具体顺序、交付内容、费用与时间取决于实际项目和确认范围。完整六步说明请查看《装修施工流程》。

核对项目身份

确认地址、物业类型、图纸版本、报价日期和计价范围。基于旧布局的报价不能可靠比较。

数量和规格一起看

每一项应在适用时写清工程、数量、材料或性能规格和单位。过于笼统的名称会让替换和遗漏难以发现。

如包含定制柜或收纳柜，应将尺寸、板材与饰面方向、门板和五金规格、运输与安装条件，以及暂定项目分别列明。可参考全屋定制与定制家具服务整理柜体需求；整体工程可查看住宅装修服务。备好现场照片和分项范围后，可通过免费报价表咨询；最终规格与价格仍以现场条件和书面报价为准。

找出暂定和业主自购项目

标明暂定金额、待选项目、业主采购和检查后再计价的工程，并写明最终差额如何计算。

先读不包含项目再看总价

核对审批、押金、保护、出入、拆除、清运、测试、清洁、运输、税费、水电和还原，接口遗漏常会造成后期争议。

付款和变更都要有记录

写明付款节点、完成证据、变更批准、价格和时间影响、缺陷报告、交付文件及适用合同。

开工或签约前检查清单

  • 地址和图纸版本
  • 分项数量与规格
  • 暂定及业主自购项目
  • 明确不包含项目
  • 付款证据和节点
  • 书面变更与交付流程

常见问题

只比较总价可以吗？

不可以，应先统一范围、规格、数量、暂定金额和不包含项目。

什么是暂定项目？

它是尚未完全确定的工程或选择所预留的金额，必须写明调整方式。

口头加项可以吗？

施工前应书面记录并批准范围、费用和工期影响。

资料来源与适用边界

  • CIDB 业主装修报价指南
  • CIDB 建筑合同指南

资料核对日期：2026 年 8 月 22 日。相关部门、管理处、顾问和产品制造商的要求可能变化；正式决定前请以项目所在地、具体范围和所选产品的最新书面资料为准。
publicCurrentProjection.content_en:
Direct answer：The best quotation is not automatically the cheapest or longest. It is the one that makes the proposed deliverable, assumptions, responsibilities and change process clear enough for both parties to use during construction.

How to use this guide: replace every point below with the property's actual dimensions, named responsibilities, approved drawings and written evidence before using it for quotation, approval or construction decisions.

Before comparing quotations: a project checklist

Before comparing individual quotations, organise the project in sequence: share site information and priorities; confirm site measurements and existing conditions; agree the design scope; review an itemised quotation and materials; confirm construction responsibilities and coordination; and record inspection, defect and handover arrangements. The sequence, deliverables, fees and timing depend on the actual project and agreed scope. See Our Renovation Process for the full six-step overview.

Check the project identity

Confirm address, property type, drawing revision, quotation date and the exact scope basis. A quotation tied to an outdated layout cannot be compared reliably.

Review quantities and specifications together

Each line should make the work, quantity, material or performance specification and unit clear where applicable. Generic labels make substitutions and omissions difficult to detect.

For fitted cabinets or storage, request separate dimensions, board and finish direction, door and hardware specifications, delivery and installation access, and any provisional items. Use the custom built-in furniture service to frame the cabinet brief, and the residential renovation service for wider works. Share site photos and an itemised scope through the free quotation form; final specifications and price depend on the site and written quotation.

Find allowances and owner-supplied items

Identify provisional sums, prime-cost items, selections pending, owner purchases and work priced after inspection. Record how final differences will be calculated.

Read exclusions before the total

Check approvals, deposits, protection, access, hacking, disposal, testing, cleaning, delivery, taxes, utilities and reinstatement. Missing interfaces often create later disputes.

Tie payments and changes to records

State payment milestones, completion evidence, variation approval, price/time impact, defect reporting, handover documents and the contract that governs the work.

Checklist before approval or start

  • Address and drawing revision
  • Itemised quantities and specifications
  • Allowances and owner-supplied items
  • Explicit exclusions
  • Payment evidence and milestones
  • Written variation and handover process

Frequently asked questions

Should I compare only the total?

No. First normalise scope, specification, quantities, allowances and exclusions.

What is a provisional item?

It is an amount for work or a selection not fully defined; the adjustment method should be written.

Are verbal additions acceptable?

Record and approve the scope, cost and schedule effect in writing before work proceeds.

Sources and scope boundary

  • CIDB homeowner guidance on quotations
  • CIDB homeowner guidance on construction contracts

Sources checked on 22 August 2026. Authority, management, consultant and manufacturer requirements can change; confirm the latest written requirements for the actual property, scope and selected product before making a final decision.

requiredText: Interior design should clarify layout flow, storage, daylight, material direction, construction feasibility, and budget priorities before renovation begins. FLASH CAST helps owners and business operators connect space planning, design concepts, custom built-in furniture, material selection, and renovation coordination after the scope is confirmed. If you are planning interior design alongside renovation, share the intended use, a floor plan or site photos, and the layout, storage and material priorities you want to review. We can then discuss how the design direction connects with the renovation scope. Specific drawings, 3D visuals, construction work and quotation support depend on site conditions and the scope agreed for your project.
Interior design services and space planning

FLASH CAST provides interior design and space planning for residential and commercial spaces, with Kuala Lumpur, Selangor and Klang Valley as its main service areas. An enquiry can start with circulation, functional zones, storage, furniture and cabinet positions, materials and visual direction, before discussing how the design connects with renovation under the confirmed scope and actual site conditions.

For kitchen or whole-home storage planning, review daily use, available dimensions and cabinet needs together. For a commercial space, start with the number of users, working or operating requirements and the zones you want to change. Specific design work, drawings, 3D visualization and construction coordination should be clarified when the project scope is confirmed.
What to prepare for an interior design enquiry
The project location, space type, approximate area and current use.
An existing floor plan, if available, and site photos showing what you want to keep or change.
Main needs, such as circulation, kitchen use, wardrobe storage or office zoning.
Material and style references, budget direction, priorities and preferred timing.

You do not need to prepare a complete design drawing before an initial enquiry. Use the existing contact or quotation route to describe the information you have, then confirm which site details the team needs next.
Planning the connection between design and renovation
1. Describe the intended use and main issues, and gather photos, a floor plan and a budget direction.
2. Review layout, circulation, storage, materials and visual direction alongside site measurements and conditions.
3. Compare the design direction with the intended work scope, and clarify drawing or visualization needs, construction coordination and quotation scope.
Specific work, deliverables and arrangements are based on the scope agreed by both parties.
What affects design and renovation quotations?

Space size, the existing layout, drawing and visualization needs, material choices, custom cabinets, revision scope and coordination requirements can affect a quotation. When comparing options, review included work, optional items and exclusions together.

Quotations are free. This does not mean that design work, 3D visuals or construction drawings are free, or automatically included in every renovation quotation. Confirm the specific fees and deliverables before agreeing the scope.

室内设计不是只挑颜色或摆家具。好的设计应先解决空间动线、收纳、采光、材料搭配、施工可行性和预算优先级。FLASH CAST 可根据确认范围，把空间规划、设计方案、定制家具、材料选择和装修协调衔接起来。 如果同时考虑室内设计与装修，请先提供空间用途、平面图或现场照片，以及想调整的布局、收纳和材料方向。我们会据此讨论设计方向与装修范围如何衔接；图纸、3D 效果图、施工及报价的具体交付，以现场条件和确认范围为准。
室内设计服务与空间规划方向
FLASH CAST 的室内设计与空间规划面向住宅和商业空间，主要服务地区为吉隆坡、雪兰莪与巴生谷。咨询可从布局动线、功能分区、收纳、家具与柜体位置、材料和视觉方向开始，再按现场条件及确认范围讨论与装修的衔接。
规划厨房或全屋收纳时，设计方向应同时考虑使用习惯、可用尺寸和柜体需求；商业空间则可先整理使用人数、工作或经营方式及需要调整的功能区。具体设计内容、图纸、3D 可视化和施工协调范围需在项目确认时逐项说明。
开始设计咨询前，建议准备这些资料
项目地点、空间类型、大致面积与当前使用状态。
现有平面图（如有）和现场照片，以及想保留或调整的位置。
主要使用需求，例如动线、厨房操作、衣物收纳或办公分区。
材料与风格参考、预算方向、优先事项及希望安排的时间。
不必为了首次咨询先制作完整设计图。可先通过现有联系或报价入口说明手头资料，再与团队确认哪些现场信息需要补充。
怎样整理设计与装修的规划顺序
1. 先说明空间用途与主要问题，整理照片、平面图及预算方向。
2. 结合现场测量和条件，讨论布局、动线、收纳、材料及视觉方向。
3. 把设计方向与拟实施范围对照，确认图纸或效果图需求、施工衔接与报价范围。
具体工作内容、交付资料和安排，以双方确认范围为准。
哪些因素会影响设计与装修报价
空间面积、现有布局、图纸与效果图需求、材料选择、定制柜体、修改范围及协调需求都会影响报价。比较方案时，建议同时核对包含内容、可选项目和未包含事项。
报价免费；这不等于设计、3D 效果图或施工图免费，也不代表这些项目自动包含在任何装修报价中。请在确认范围前核对具体费用与交付内容。
把设计方向连接到相关服务

Interior design should clarify layout flow, storage, daylight, material direction, construction feasibility, and budget priorities before renovation begins. FLASH CAST helps owners and business operators connect space planning, design concepts, custom built-in furniture, material selection, and renovation coordination after the scope is confirmed. If you are planning interior design alongside renovation, share the intended use, a floor plan or site photos, and the layout, storage and material priorities you want to review. We can then discuss how the design direction connects with the renovation scope. Specific drawings, 3D visuals, construction work and quotation support depend on site conditions and the scope agreed for your project.

Interior design services and space planning

FLASH CAST provides interior design and space planning for residential and commercial spaces, with Kuala Lumpur, Selangor and Klang Valley as its main service areas. An enquiry can start with circulation, functional zones, storage, furniture and cabinet positions, materials and visual direction, before discussing how the design connects with renovation under the confirmed scope and actual site conditions.

For kitchen or whole-home storage planning, review daily use, available dimensions and cabinet needs together. For a commercial space, start with the number of users, working or operating requirements and the zones you want to change. Specific design work, drawings, 3D visualization and construction coordination should be clarified when the project scope is confirmed.

What to prepare for an interior design enquiry

The project location, space type, approximate area and current use.

An existing floor plan, if available, and site photos showing what you want to keep or change.

Main needs, such as circulation, kitchen use, wardrobe storage or office zoning.

Material and style references, budget direction, priorities and preferred timing.

You do not need to prepare a complete design drawing before an initial enquiry. Use the existing contact or quotation route to describe the information you have, then confirm which site details the team needs next.

Planning the connection between design and renovation

1. Describe the intended use and main issues, and gather photos, a floor plan and a budget direction.

2. Review layout, circulation, storage, materials and visual direction alongside site measurements and conditions.

3. Compare the design direction with the intended work scope, and clarify drawing or visualization needs, construction coordination and quotation scope.

Specific work, deliverables and arrangements are based on the scope agreed by both parties.

What affects design and renovation quotations?

Space size, the existing layout, drawing and visualization needs, material choices, custom cabinets, revision scope and coordination requirements can affect a quotation. When comparing options, review included work, optional items and exclusions together.

Quotations are free. This does not mean that design work, 3D visuals or construction drawings are free, or automatically included in every renovation quotation. Confirm the specific fees and deliverables before agreeing the scope.

Connect the design direction with the relevant service

Whole-home cabinets, wardrobes and storage: explore whole-house custom and built-in furniture.

Kitchen layout, cabinets and materials: explore kitchen renovation and cabinet planning.

The wider residential work scope: explore residential renovation services.

Work areas, meeting spaces and office storage: explore office renovation and space planning.

Retail and operating spaces: explore shop renovation and commercial space planning.

With the project location, space type, photos or an existing floor plan ready, use the interior design and renovation quotation enquiry to explain the scope you want assessed.

室内设计不是只挑颜色或摆家具。好的设计应先解决空间动线、收纳、采光、材料搭配、施工可行性和预算优先级。FLASH CAST 可根据确认范围，把空间规划、设计方案、定制家具、材料选择和装修协调衔接起来。 如果同时考虑室内设计与装修，请先提供空间用途、平面图或现场照片，以及想调整的布局、收纳和材料方向。我们会据此讨论设计方向与装修范围如何衔接；图纸、3D 效果图、施工及报价的具体交付，以现场条件和确认范围为准。

室内设计服务与空间规划方向

FLASH CAST 的室内设计与空间规划面向住宅和商业空间，主要服务地区为吉隆坡、雪兰莪与巴生谷。咨询可从布局动线、功能分区、收纳、家具与柜体位置、材料和视觉方向开始，再按现场条件及确认范围讨论与装修的衔接。

规划厨房或全屋收纳时，设计方向应同时考虑使用习惯、可用尺寸和柜体需求；商业空间则可先整理使用人数、工作或经营方式及需要调整的功能区。具体设计内容、图纸、3D 可视化和施工协调范围需在项目确认时逐项说明。

开始设计咨询前，建议准备这些资料

项目地点、空间类型、大致面积与当前使用状态。

现有平面图（如有）和现场照片，以及想保留或调整的位置。

主要使用需求，例如动线、厨房操作、衣物收纳或办公分区。

材料与风格参考、预算方向、优先事项及希望安排的时间。

不必为了首次咨询先制作完整设计图。可先通过现有联系或报价入口说明手头资料，再与团队确认哪些现场信息需要补充。

怎样整理设计与装修的规划顺序

1. 先说明空间用途与主要问题，整理照片、平面图及预算方向。

2. 结合现场测量和条件，讨论布局、动线、收纳、材料及视觉方向。

3. 把设计方向与拟实施范围对照，确认图纸或效果图需求、施工衔接与报价范围。

具体工作内容、交付资料和安排，以双方确认范围为准。

哪些因素会影响设计与装修报价

空间面积、现有布局、图纸与效果图需求、材料选择、定制柜体、修改范围及协调需求都会影响报价。比较方案时，建议同时核对包含内容、可选项目和未包含事项。

报价免费；这不等于设计、3D 效果图或施工图免费，也不代表这些项目自动包含在任何装修报价中。请在确认范围前核对具体费用与交付内容。

全屋柜体、衣柜和收纳需求：查看全屋定制与定制家具。

厨房动线、柜体和材料：查看厨房装修与橱柜规划。

店铺和经营空间：查看店铺装修与商业空间规划。

requiredText: A bathroom renovation is not only about choosing tiles and sanitary fittings. Long-term usability depends on waterproofing scope, drainage slope, floor trap position, wall and floor tile works, shower screen planning, vanity storage, toilet position, ventilation, lighting, and maintenance access. FLASH CAST can help connect site inspection, waterproofing direction, tile and fitting selection, plumbing review, and renovation coordination after the scope is confirmed.
How should demolition, waterproofing and fittings be scoped separately?

Share current leakage or usability issues, bathroom photos and the items you want to retain or replace. Review drainage, pipes, floor traps, wall and floor finishes, waterproofing, fittings and vanity coordination on site, then distinguish removal, repairs, new installation and reinstatement in the quotation. Inspection, work and acceptance requirements follow the site and agreed scope.
What daily-use arrangements should be discussed before bathroom work?

Explain whether the home is occupied, whether another bathroom is available, and any access or building work-hour restrictions. Discuss material delivery, protection of adjacent areas, removal of waste, work dependencies and periods that may affect bathroom use. Actual arrangements depend on the site and agreed work.
How can bathroom materials and quotation items be compared?

List wall and floor tiles, fittings, shower screens, vanity units and other items to retain or replace. Check specifications, quantities and whether plumbing changes, waterproofing and reinstatement are included. Record inspection-dependent items and optional upgrades separately, and compare the written scope rather than images or totals alone.

浴室装修不能只看瓷砖和洁具外观。真正影响后期使用的是防水范围、排水坡度、地漏位置、墙地砖铺贴、淋浴区隔断、洗手盆和镜柜收纳、马桶位置、通风、照明和维护便利性。FLASH CAST 可先从现场检查和需求确认开始，把防水、瓷砖、给排水、洁具、浴室柜和施工范围衔接起来。
拆改、防水和洁具怎样分别确认范围？
先提供现有漏水或使用问题、浴室照片及希望保留或更换的项目。现场核对排水、水管、地漏、墙地面、防水、洁具和浴室柜之间的衔接，再把拆除、维修、新装和恢复工程分开列入报价。具体检查、施工及验收要求以现场条件和确认范围为准。
施工期间的日常使用安排要先确认什么？
说明住宅是否有人居住、是否有其他可用浴室、进出场和物业施工时段限制。与团队确认材料搬运、相邻区域保护、清运和各工序衔接，以及哪些时段可能影响浴室使用；实际安排需按现场和施工范围确认。
怎样比较浴室装修的材料与报价项目？
对照需要保留与更换的墙地砖、洁具、淋浴屏、浴室柜和其他项目，核对规格、数量、给排水调整、防水和恢复工程是否包含。把待检查事项与可选升级分开记录，按书面范围比较，而不是只比较照片或总价。

橱柜规划前怎样整理家电与现场资料？
先整理拟保留或更换的冰箱、灶具、烤箱和其他家电清单，以及尺寸与现有位置。连同厨房照片、主要尺寸、给排水和插座位置交给团队核对，再讨论地柜、吊柜、高柜、台面及收纳。最终尺寸、点位和安装衔接须经现场确认。

比较方案时，把橱柜尺寸与配置、门板和材料方向、台面、五金、家电点位、给排水、湿作、拆除与安装分别核对。写清保留项目、业主自备项目、可选项目和待检查事项，让两份报价按相近范围比较；不要只看每尺价格或总价。
厨房与其他空间收纳应怎样衔接？
厨房橱柜应围绕煮食、备餐、清洗、家电和台面规划；卧室衣柜、电视柜、鞋柜和跨房间收纳则可由全屋定制服务继续讨论。共同确认柜体与现场条件，分别列出各空间的材料、五金、制作及安装范围。

requiredText: For an office fit-out in Kuala Lumpur or Selangor, start with the actual unit and its intended use. Share a floor plan or site photos, approximate area, headcount, visitor flow, the items to retain, access rules and any building-management requirements. These details help separate essential operational work from optional finishes before a quotation is prepared.

A written scope can then identify the agreed layout, partitions, reception and meeting areas, workstations, storage, lighting, flooring, electrical and data points, selected built-ins and material direction. It should also record owner-supplied items, exclusions, restricted work hours, management submissions and dependencies between trades. Any drawing or document support, responsibility and cost must be confirmed against the actual building requirements and agreed scope.

New fit-out work and lease handback or reinstatement obligations should be reviewed as separate scopes. If the tenancy has a handback clause, share it for review; reinstatement is included only when the written quotation expressly covers it. Final price, programme and any approval requirements depend on the site review, confirmed work and the property rules. No fixed price, completion date or approval outcome is promised here.
How does an equipment list help define an office fit-out?

Group equipment quantities, intended positions and retained facilities by workstation, meeting room, reception, pantry and storage area. Identify which items belong to the owner, equipment supplier or agreed fit-out scope. The office M&E and IT planning checklist helps organise interface questions. Electrical capacity, professional design, testing and connection requirements must be confirmed by the relevant qualified parties using the building information; the equipment list is not a technical design or permission to proceed.
How should office quotations and handover scope be compared?

Use the same layout, material and equipment list when comparing proposals. Separate retained and new items, supply and installation responsibilities, access restrictions, unresolved items and exclusions. Before handover, agree which project records are needed and who follows up any outstanding issues; the renovation handover and issue-recording checklist provides discussion prompts. Once plans, photos and equipment details are ready, request an office quotation. Deliverables remain subject to the written scope.

书面工程范围可逐项确认布局、隔间、接待区与会议室、工作站、收纳、灯光、地面、电力及数据点、局部定制柜和材料方向，并写明业主自备项目、排除项、允许施工时段、管理处提交资料与工种之间的依赖。图纸或文件协助的责任、费用和范围，应按实际大楼要求及双方确认内容厘清。
新办公室 fit-out 与租约退租复原义务应分开核对；如租约有交还条件，可提供条款供范围讨论，只有书面报价明确列入时才视为包含复原工程。最终价格、工期及审批要求仍取决于现场查看、确认的工程范围和物业规定；本页不承诺固定价格、完工日期或审批结果。
办公室设备清单怎样帮助确认装修范围？
可按工位、会议室、接待区、茶水间和储物区整理设备数量、使用位置及希望保留的设施，再标注由业主、设备供应商或装修范围分别负责的项目。需要进一步梳理接口时，查看 办公室机电与IT规划检查清单。实际电气容量、专业设计、测试和连接要求应由相关合格人员按建筑资料确认；设备清单本身不代表技术设计或施工许可。
如何比较办公室报价与交付范围？
比较时沿用同一布局、材料和设备清单，分别确认保留与新增项目、供应与安装责任、进场限制、待核实项和排除项。交付前还应确认需要保留哪些项目记录，以及问题由谁跟进；可用 装修交付与问题记录清单 整理问项。准备好图纸、照片和设备资料后，提交办公室报价咨询，最终交付内容以书面范围为准。

requiredText: Direct answer: FLASH CAST plans whole-house custom furniture, built-in storage and fitted wardrobes for homes and commercial spaces across Kuala Lumpur, Selangor and Klang Valley. Each scope is organised around site measurements, daily use, storage categories, materials, hardware, delivery and installation conditions instead of a fixed package.
Plan around the room and how it is used

The scope can cover fitted wardrobes, walk-in wardrobes, TV units, shoe cabinets, sideboards, display cabinets, bookshelves, study areas and other built-in storage. Kitchen cabinetry and the wider kitchen workflow belong on the dedicated custom kitchen and kitchen renovation service, keeping the search intent of both pages clear.
What shapes the quotation

The quotation is assessed from site measurements, cabinet dimensions and zones, board and finish direction, doors, worktops, hardware, internal accessories, lighting coordination, delivery, lift and installation access, and coordination with other trades. Material directions can include Melamine, Acrylic and Solid Wood; final specifications remain subject to approved samples, site conditions and the written quotation.
Move from research to an enquiry

Review wardrobe materials, storage cabinet materials, the Bangsar walk-in wardrobe reference and the Malaysia built-in cabinet cost guide. When the location, floor plan or site photos and main storage needs are ready, request a free quotation. Site measurement is free within 30 km of the company or service point; travel beyond 30 km is chargeable and the amount must be confirmed first.
Which choices should be recorded when confirming a design?

Keep cabinet positions and dimensions, internal divisions, doors and finishes, handles or opening method, hardware and accessories in one confirmation list, marking items that still need site review. Wardrobes should reflect the actual clothing, drawers and access habits rather than appearance or total length alone; see the custom wardrobe quotation guide. Separately confirm who supplies drawings, samples, revisions and installation, and which deliverables are included in the written scope.
What records make installation handover easier to follow up?

Review visible finishes, door and drawer operation, accessories and outstanding adjustments with the responsible party against the agreed list. Record the cabinet location, photos, proposed follow-up and owner for each issue, then retain the recheck result; methods and responsibilities follow the project agreement. Use the handover recording checklist and ask for care information for the selected materials and hardware, applicable after-sales terms and contact details. This does not add a fixed warranty scope or an unconfirmed performance promise.
直接答案：FLASH CAST 为吉隆坡、雪兰莪与巴生谷的住宅及商业空间规划全屋定制、定制家具与定制衣柜。方案会按现场尺寸、日常使用、收纳分类、材料、五金、搬运和安装条件整理，而不是套用一个固定套餐。
按空间和使用方式规划
可讨论的范围包括定制衣柜、walk-in wardrobe、电视柜、鞋柜、餐边柜、展示柜、书柜、工作区与其他嵌入式收纳。若需求属于厨房橱柜与厨房整体动线，应进入独立的 定制厨房与厨房装修服务，避免两个页面争夺同一搜索意图。
报价前先确认的项目
报价会根据现场量度、柜体尺寸与分区、板材和饰面、门板、台面、五金、内部配件、灯光衔接、搬运、电梯、安装通道及其他工种配合范围评估。可讨论的材料方向包括 Melamine、Acrylic 与 Solid Wood，最终规格应以样板、现场条件和书面报价为准。
从参考到咨询
可先查看 衣柜材料、收纳柜材料、Bangsar walk-in wardrobe 参考 和 马来西亚定制柜报价影响因素。准备地点、平面图或现场照片及主要收纳需求后，可前往 获取免费报价。距离公司或服务点 30 公里以内可免费上门量房；超过 30 公里会收费，具体费用需先确认。
确认方案时，需要把哪些选择记录下来？
可把柜体位置与尺寸、内部划分、门板与饰面、把手或开门方式、五金及配件整理到同一份确认清单，并标注哪些仍待现场核对。衣柜应按实际衣物、抽屉和取用习惯讨论，而不是只比较外观或总长度；详细问项可参考 定制衣柜报价比较指南。图纸、样板、修改与安装由谁提供，以及包含哪些交付，应在书面范围中分别确认。
安装交付时怎样保留可跟进的记录？
与负责方对照已确认清单，记录可见饰面、门和抽屉操作、配件及待调整项。每个问题写明柜体位置、照片、需确认的处理方式和跟进人，再保留复查结果；具体检查方法与责任按项目约定。可参考 装修交付记录清单，并询问所选材料与五金的保养说明、适用售后条款和联系方法。这不新增固定保修范围或未经确认的材料性能承诺。

faqs_en.a: Whole-house planning coordinates cabinetry, storage and installation across several rooms. A single wardrobe, TV unit, shoe cabinet, display cabinet or study area can also be discussed on its own. The final scope depends on the site and actual requirements.
faqs_en.q: How does whole-house custom furniture differ from a single built-in?

faqs_en.a: Share the project location, a floor plan or site photos, key dimensions, what needs to be stored, equipment positions and any material or visual direction. If the information is incomplete, start with the requirements and confirm whether a site measurement is needed.
faqs_en.q: What should I prepare for the first consultation?

faqs_en.a: The main factors are cabinet dimensions and zones, board and finish, doors, worktops, hardware, internal accessories, lighting coordination, delivery and installation access, and coordination with other trades. A fixed total can only follow a confirmed scope and site conditions.
faqs_en.q: What affects a custom furniture quotation?

faqs_en.a: The three material directions differ in appearance, care, construction and cost. Compare them against the room, cleaning needs, budget direction, approved samples and written specification instead of choosing from images alone.
faqs_en.q: How should I compare Melamine, Acrylic and Solid Wood?

faqs_en.a: It can be discussed together, but kitchen cabinetry also depends on kitchen workflow, appliances, worktops, plumbing, electrical points and related work. The dedicated kitchen service page handles that detailed scope and search intent.
faqs_en.q: Is kitchen cabinetry included in this service?

faqs_en.a: No. Price and timing depend on site dimensions, materials, hardware, fabrication and installation scope, access and coordination with other trades, and remain subject to the final written quotation and schedule.
faqs_en.q: Can you promise a fixed price or completion period before measurement?

faqs_en.a: The quotation is free. Site measurement is free within 30 km of the company or service point; travel beyond 30 km is chargeable and the amount must be confirmed from the location first.
faqs_en.q: Are site measurement and quotations free?

faqs_zh.a: 全屋定制会同时整理多个空间的柜体、收纳和安装衔接；单个衣柜、电视柜、鞋柜、展示柜或书桌区域也可以独立讨论。最终范围按现场条件和实际需求确认。
faqs_zh.q: 全屋定制与单个定制柜有什么区别？

faqs_zh.a: 建议提供项目地点、平面图或现场照片、主要尺寸、需要收纳的物品、现有设备位置，以及偏好的材料或外观方向。资料不完整时，可先说明需求，再确认是否需要现场量度。
faqs_zh.q: 第一次咨询需要准备什么？

faqs_zh.a: 主要包括柜体尺寸与分区、板材与饰面、门板、台面、五金、内部配件、灯光衔接、搬运与安装条件，以及与其他工种配合的范围。固定总价只能在范围与现场条件确认后提供。
faqs_zh.q: 哪些因素会影响定制家具报价？

faqs_zh.a: 三种材料方向的外观、保养、结构做法和成本不同。应结合使用位置、清洁需求、预算方向、样板和书面规格比较，不能只按图片决定。
faqs_zh.q: Melamine、Acrylic 和 Solid Wood 应怎样选择？

faqs_zh.a: 可以一起讨论，但厨房橱柜涉及厨房动线、家电、台面、水电和其他施工衔接，网站由独立的厨房服务页承接详细需求与搜索意图。
faqs_zh.q: 厨房橱柜也属于这个服务吗？

faqs_zh.a: 不能。价格和工期需根据现场尺寸、材料、五金、制作与安装范围、进场条件和其他工种衔接评估，并以最终书面报价和排期为准。
faqs_zh.q: 可以先承诺固定价格或固定工期吗？

faqs_zh.a: 报价免费。距离公司或服务点 30 公里以内可免费上门量房；超过 30 公里会收费，具体费用需要先根据地点确认。

  • Existing floors, columns, lighting, drainage and site services.
